invariants.rationale: The fileName parameter represents a path and is expected to be non-null for loading resources.
A resource path is expected to be non-empty; an empty string would be an invalid file name.
According to the Javadoc, only .tmx or .tmj files are supported for loading maps.
File paths typically do not start with a whitespace, which could indicate an invalid or mistyped file name.
Java strings that contain a null character are generally invalid as file names.
